metadata.name: dsh-ping-me

paragraphs.text: Push-only phone notifications for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) via ntfy: turn results, approvals, question
s, failures, and alerts from automation tasks. Nobody can talk back to your agents.
A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that sends **notifications to your phone** through ntfy: when a turn
is done, when an agent needs your approval or has a question, and when something fails. Start a lon
g task, walk away, and your phone tells you when to come back.
**Automation tasks can alert you, too.** A `ping_me` tool lets an agent run by dsh's Schedule ping y
ou only when it actually found a problem. A daily "all fine" stays quiet.
**Push only.** The plugin publishes and never subscribes. Nothing anyone sends to your topic can eve
r reach your agents.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What you get
| Notification | When | Sound |

| ✅ **Turn finished**, with the reply | a turn you started is done | normal |
| ✋ **Needs your appro
val** / ❓ **Has a question** | an approval or `ask_user_question` is waiting; the question and its o

ptions are in the notification | loud |
| ❌ **Failed** | error, output limit, policy block. Your own

Stop stays silent | high |
| ⚠️ **Automation alert** | an automation task called `ping_me` because

it found a problem | high |
| 🟢 **Fix the login bug · running bash · 2m 10s** (optional) | live stat
us while a turn runs, updated in place, then turns into the ✅ result | silent |
- **Open dsh button:** every notification has one. It only opens dsh in your browser, and you still

need your dsh login. The address is detected from the browser you use dsh in.
- **Labelled by sessio

n:** notifications carry the session's title, so you know which agent it is.
- **Subagents stay quie

t:** their parent reports.
- **Long replies** are cut to fit ntfy's 4 KB limit and end with "full re

arent reports.
- **Long replies** are cut to fit ntfy's 4 KB limit and end with "full reply in dsh".
## Install
Into your dsh **web profile** (`web` below is the profile name; use whichever profile backs your web
GUI). From a source checkout, use `pnpm dsh` instead of `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart dsh once, then open **Plugins → dsh-ping-me**. Requires dsh 0.2.0 or newer and Node 20+. The
re's no build step; the one runtime dependency is `qrcode`, for the QR code.
**Let your agent guide you:** ask any dsh session to *"help me set up dsh-ping-me"*. The `ping_me` t
ool points agents to `SETUP-GUIDE.md`, a step-by-step script with checks and troubleshooting that sh
ips with the plugin.
## Connect your phone
No account, no password: the plugin makes a random topic for you. Think of a topic as a private radi
o channel that dsh broadcasts on and your phone listens to.

1. Install the free **ntfy** app (Android, iPhone, F-Droid).
2. Subscribe to your topic:
- **Android
:** pick **Android** in the card and scan the QR code with your camera. The topic opens in the ntfy

app; tap **Subscribe**.
- **iPhone:** the iPhone app can't be opened by a QR code. In the app tap **
+** (top right), enter the topic name from the card, leave **Use another server** off, and tap **Sub

scribe**.
3. Press **Send test notification**.
**Missing notifications on Android?** Allow notifications for ntfy, and set its battery usage to *Un
tifications on Android?** Allow notifications for ntfy, and set its battery usage to *Unrestricted*.
## Automation tasks
dsh's Schedule posts a prompt into a session at the time you set. Tell it when to ping you:
> Every day at 8:00 Europe/Berlin: check `~/app/logs/backup.log` for the last 24 h. If a backup fail
ed, call `ping_me` with the evidence. If everything is fine, don't ping.
- **Only from automation tasks:** `ping_me` works only in turns an automation task started. In a nor

mal chat it refuses, so it can't turn into spam.
- **Hourly cap:** 10 pings by default.
- **Quiet ru
ns:** the reply of an automation run isn't pushed by default, so the daily "all fine" stays quiet. Y
ou'll still hear about failures and questions. Switch on *Automation runs finished* to get every run

.
- **Log:** every `ping_me` call, sent or refused, is logged to `~/.dsh/ping-me/log.jsonl`.
## For agents: the `ping_me` tool
- **`ping_me({ title, message, urgent? })`:** pushes an alert to the user's phone. `message` can be

markdown. `urgent` sets max priority.
- **Root sessions only:** subagents don't get the tool. Schedu

le delivers to root sessions anyway.
- **Cheap to carry:** the tool definition is about 160 tokens p
er request, including the pointer to `SETUP-GUIDE.md`.
## Security
- **Push only:** no subscription, no reply handling, no notification buttons that post back. Compare
`dsh-ntfy-remote`, which injects anything posted to a session's topic as your command, on a topic d

erived from the session id.
- **The topic is a secret:** 96 random bits, so nobody can guess it. But
anyone who has it can read your notifications, and those can include agent replies. Don't share it;

**New topic** in the card replaces it.
- **More privacy:** run your own ntfy server, or use a reser
ved topic on ntfy.sh. Enter the server and an access token under *Advanced*. The token is kept in ds

h's credential store and never shown again.
- **Login required:** the settings routes go through dsh
's own `/api` layer (`ctx.connection.fetch`), so only browsers logged in to your dsh can use them.
## Limits
- **ntfy.sh free tier: about 250 messages a day.** Each live-status update costs one, so leave it of

f on ntfy.sh or use your own server.
- **No "dsh died" alert:** ntfy.sh can't cancel or postpone a d
elayed message (tested 2026-10-25), so a dead-man alert would fire after every turn. Instead, the li

ve status shows an "Updated HH:MM" time: if it stops moving, dsh stopped.
- **No "stuck" alarm:** mo
del output streams outside the events plugins see, so a model thinking for minutes can't be told apa

rt from a hang.
- **Answer in dsh:** approvals and questions are answered in dsh, not from the phone
. That's the price of push only.
## Tested
Verified live with dsh 0.2.1 on Linux, a local 27B model and ntfy.sh, checking every push on the top
ified live with dsh 0.2.1 on Linux, a local 27B model and ntfy.sh, checking every push on the topic:

- **Chat turn:** ✅ with the reply, the session title and the Open dsh button.
- **Question:** ❓ loud

, with the question and its options.
